payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.intro: Courier payout lines that need a person: held lines wait for the courier's details, unresolved lines need settling against the payment provider.

hold.unknown-courier: Courier not found in the fleet

empty.title: Nothing here
empty.body: No payout line is in this state.

no-access.title: You don't have access to payouts
no-access.body: Your role doesn't include the payouts ledger.

settle.title: Settle this payout line?
settle.body: The line of {amount} is checked against the payment provider's transfers. If the provider holds the transfer, the line is marked paid; if it holds none, the line fails and the courier's balance gets the amount back. Follow the runbook for unresolved lines.

adjust.title: Adjust this courier's balance
adjust.body: The adjustment is recorded in the ledger and audited. Enter the amount before tax; any tax due is added.
adjust.amount-invalid: Enter an amount above zero, with no more digits after the point than the currency has.
adjust.already: This adjustment was already recorded; nothing new was added.

payouts.key-reused: This form was already used for a different adjustment. Close it and start again.
payouts.line-state: The line is no longer unresolved. Reload to see its state.
payouts.settle-too-early: The line is under an hour old and the provider has no transfer yet. Try again later.
payouts.settle-mismatch: The provider's transfer doesn't match this line. Check it by hand, following the runbook.
payouts.settle-ambiguous: The provider holds more than one possible transfer. Check it by hand, following the runbook.
payouts.provider-unavailable: The payment provider can't be reached right now. Try again in a few minutes.
payouts.line-not-found: This payout line was not found.
payouts.currency-mismatch: The amount must be in the courier's balance currency.
